components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action. Used for primary actions like booking, confirming, and continuing.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.55 0.2 260); color: oklch(0.99 0 0); padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; border: none; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.5 0.2 260); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.55 0.2 260); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action. Used for secondary actions like cancel, back, or skip.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.96 0.01 260); color: oklch(0.22 0.04 265); padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; border: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.2 0.04 265 / 0.04); transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.92 0.01 260); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.55 0.2 260); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Content container for sessions, mentor profiles, and feature blocks.
components.html:
Session with Maria

Tomorrow at 3:00 PM

Spanish conversation practice
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.01 260 / 0.4); background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.18 0.03 265); box-shadow: 0 1px 1px oklch(0.2 0.04 265 / 0.03); transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 1px oklch(0.2 0.04 265 / 0.03), 0 8px 30px -10px oklch(0.35 0.12 265 / 0.18); } .ds-card-header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 0; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.4; color: oklch(0.5 0.03 260); margin: 0; } .ds-card-content { padding: 0 16px 16px; } .ds-card-content p { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field for forms, search, and data entry.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 36px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.01 260); background: transparent; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: oklch(0.18 0.03 265); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.2 0.04 265 / 0.04); transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.5 0.03 260); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: oklch(0.85 0.02 260); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.55 0.2 260); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.55 0.2 260); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Status indicator for session state, streak count, and mentor availability.
components.css: .ds-badge-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 8px; border: none; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; background: oklch(0.55 0.2 260); color: oklch(0.99 0 0); transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-badge-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.5 0.2 260); } .ds-badge-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 8px; border: none; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; background: oklch(0.96 0.01 260); color: oklch(0.22 0.04 265); transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-badge-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.92 0.01 260); } .ds-badge-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 8px; border: none; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.18 0.03 265); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Navigation entry in the authenticated app shell sidebar.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: oklch(0.5 0.03 260); text-decoration: none; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: oklch(0.94 0.04 285 / 0.5); color: oklch(0.28 0.1 285); } .ds-nav-item.active { background: oklch(0.95 0.03 265); color: oklch(0.55 0.2 260); } .ds-nav-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-label { white-space: nowrap; }

components.description: Modal overlay for confirmations, forms, and focused tasks.

components.css: .ds-dialog-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 50; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); } .ds-dialog { position: fixed; left: 50%; top: 50%; z-index: 50; width: 100%; max-width: 448px; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); display: grid; gap: 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.01 260 / 0.4); background: oklch(0.99 0.005 260); padding: 24px; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px oklch(0.2 0.04 265 / 0.03), 0 8px 30px -10px oklch(0.35 0.12 265 / 0.18); } .ds-dialog-header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-dialog-title { font-family: Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 0; color: oklch(0.18 0.03 265); } .ds-dialog-body p { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; color: oklch(0.18 0.03 265); } .ds-dialog-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; padding-top: 8px; }

narrative.overview:
Lingua's design language is built around clarity, flow, and intellectual warmth. Every interface decision serves the student's focus: the palette stays cool and breathable, typography balances editorial authority with operational readability, and motion supports comprehension without distraction. The system treats language learning as an act of thinking and connection, not transaction.

Brand lives in restraint. The Twilight Auth primary appears sparingly to guide attention, while the bulk of the surface remains on Cool Paper. Depth is conveyed through subtle tonal layering and restrained elevation rather than heavy ornamentation.
keyCharacteristics: Deep violet-primary used as directional signal, not decoration
Typography pairing of Instrument Serif, Sora, and Inter
Subtle motion that supports comprehension without distraction

rules.name: The Twilight Auth Rule
rules.body: Primary appears on ≤15% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point; overuse dilutes direction into decoration.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Every screen uses at most two type families. Instrument Serif is reserved for display; Sora and Inter share the operational voice.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, elevation, focus).

dos: Do use Twilight Auth on primary actions only. Let its rarity create urgency.
Do keep body text on Cool Paper or Pure Surface. Never place long-form text on tinted backgrounds.
Do use the 8px spacing grid. 4px increments exist for tight controls; 24px and 32px for section breathing room.
Do pair Instrument Serif with Sora or Inter, never alone. Serif is display-only.
Do use the shadow vocabulary as described. Do not invent new shadows.
donts: Don't place Twilight Auth text on non-white backgrounds without verifying contrast.
Don't stack multiple accent colors in a single component. One accent per element.
Don't use border-heavy outlines for primary interaction. Use shadow and tonal shift instead.
Don't break the 8px rhythm with arbitrary spacing values like 7px, 13px, or 19px.
Don't use decorative gradients on operational surfaces. Gradients are reserved for landing page hero moments only.
